text:
Ryan (AM): FYI — Brightwell wants to switch from PO to credit card for the upcoming renewal to avoid delay. They asked if we can accept card and ship immediately. Deadline is next Tue EOD.
Melanie (CS): oh interesting. who’s listed on the card? CFO?
Ryan (AM): CFO left last week. Payments team says card is company card (operations@brightwell). Finance flagged potential fraud because cardholder name != signer on contract.
Ajay (RevOps): can we do a risk-based approach: accept card + require signed payment authorization + 2FA check? we’ve used that before on small deals.
Courtney (Legal): we need a signed amendment if payer != contract signer. Wet-sign or DocuSign with ID verification. Also need to track signatory authority per SOW.
Maya (Finance): we can take card but need a counter-signed payment auth and proof of cardholder role. Otherwise must have a PO. If card + auth, mark transaction with manual review tag.
Ryan (AM): timeline: customer wants to close tomorrow if possible. They can sign docs today but need us to accept card to process.
Melanie (CS): i’ll open a one-pager for the customer: "card payment + authorization" workflow. Quick question — do we offer a short extension if they go PO instead?
Ajay (RevOps): propose two paths: 1) Expedited card path: card charge + signed payment authorization doc + Ops 2FA + billing manual review. 2) PO path: standard PO + 2-week renewal grace, 2% prorate credit as courtesy.
Courtney (Legal): draft language for amendment: one paragraph authorizing payment by alternate payer, indemnity for chargebacks, and confirmation of signatory authority. I can draft now.
Maya (Finance): if we take card, please route to billing queue "manual_review_cc" and tag with invoice ref. We’ll hold for 48 hrs for fraud checks. if passed, mark paid.
billing-bot: Invoice preview generated: invoice_2026-0847 preview (amount: $78,000) — https://billing.redwood/invoice/preview/2026-0847
Melanie (CS): customer shared a signed PO template but not completed. I pushed them to fill card auth form. They said CFO can sign today.
Ryan (AM): @Courtney when you have amendment can you paste here? we need to send to customer by noon.
Courtney (Legal): Draft ready — pasted below. Please review: ``Amendment: Brightwell authorizes payment by cardholder (name, email). Cardholder confirms authority to charge. Company agrees to hold Redwood harmless for authorized charges.`` Short and specific.
Ajay (RevOps): looks good. Add a line: "Payment will be subject to a 48-hour manual verification window."
Courtney (Legal): added. final version attached.
Melanie (CS): Sent amendment + card auth form to ops@brightwell. They confirmed CFO will sign and return by 11:30.
Maya (Finance): once returned, route to billing queue. I’ll run fraud checks ASAP and confirm within 3 hours.
Ryan (AM): thanks team — if fraud checks fail, we switch to PO path and apply the 2% credit + 2-week extension. I’ll flag the customer.
Melanie (CS): noted. will update onboarding timeline in Gainsight and tag renewal risk = "medium" until payment clears.
Ajay (RevOps): please PM me if we need to create a one-off payment method in Stripe/CC vault. I can approve.
billing-bot: Payment method "temp_card_brightwell" created by Ajay. Manual hold applied.
Maya (Finance): Received signed amendment + card auth. Starting verification now. ETA 2 hours.
Melanie (CS): :thumbsup: keep me posted — I’ll prep onboarding kickoff once payment is good.
Ryan (AM): big thanks everyone. if anything blocks, call me.
Courtney (Legal): one more note — save signed amendment to contract folder and cc legal@redwood for records.
Melanie (CS): done after we get the PDF.
Maya (Finance): Verification passed. Card cleared. Marking invoice_2026-0847 as paid.
billing-bot: Invoice invoice_2026-0847 status updated -> PAID (transaction id tx_9a8b7c).
Ryan (AM): amazing. closing the loop with the customer now. closing risk -> low.
Melanie (CS): updated Gainsight and moved renewal to "closed" stage. thanks everyone :tada:
